nights.title: Liana Flores
nights.name: Liana Flores
nights.extract: Liana Flores is a British-Brazilian singer-songwriter and guitarist. After independently releasing two extended plays The Water's Fine! (2018) and Recently (2019), her debut studio album Flower of the Soul was released under Verve and Fiction in June 2024.

en.who: Liana Flores is a british-brazilian singer-songwriter and guitarist. her debut studio album, Flower of the Soul, came out in June 2024.
